Nowcasting with a Bayesian negative binomial model fitted by 'INLA'

Fonte: R/nowcasting_inla.R
nowcasting_inla.Rd

Estimates the number of events that have already started but are not yet notified. The main use is to estimate how many cases in an outbreak have already started their symptoms but has not yet notified. nowcasting_inla, fits a statistical distribution to the empirical distribution of time of delay between onset date and report date.

Uso

nowcasting_inla(
  dataset,
  bins_age = "SI-PNI",
  trim.data = 0,
  Dmax = 15,
  wdw = 30,
  use.epiweek = TRUE,
  age_col,
  date_onset,
  date_report,
  data.by.week = FALSE,
  return.age = NULL,
  silent = FALSE,
  K = 0,
  trajectories = FALSE,
  zero_inflated = FALSE,
  timeREmodel = "rw2",
  INLAoutput = FALSE,
  INLAoutputOnly = FALSE,
  WAIC = FALSE,
  DIC = FALSE,
  ...
)

Argumentos

dataset

A data.frame with at least 2 columns, date of onset and date of report. It can have a third column, a stratum column by which the data will be stratified, usually age.

bins_age

Age bins to do the nowcasting, it receive a vector of age bins, or options between, "SI-PNI", "10 years", "5 years". The default is "SI-PNI".

trim.data

(in weeks) Number of most recent weeks to trim out of the data before estimation. Default is 0 weeks.

Dmax

(in weeks) Maximum reporting delay considered by the model. Cases reported with a longer delay are discarded. Default is 15 weeks.

wdw

(in weeks) Length of the time window, counted back from the last onset date, used to fit the model. Default is 30 weeks.

use.epiweek

If TRUE, it uses the CDC epiweek definition where the week starts on Sunday, if FALSE, the week ends at the weekday of the last record date. Default is TRUE

age_col

Column with the age (in years) of each case. If given, the structured (age-stratified) model is fitted.

date_onset

Column of dates of onset of the events, normally date of onset of first symptoms of cases.

date_report

Column of dates of report of the events, normally the date the notification was recorded in the system.

data.by.week

If TRUE, also returns the delay-triangle data used to fit the model (element 'data'). Default is FALSE.

return.age

Deprecated. If the estimate by Age should be returned. Default is TRUE.

silent

Deprecated. Should the warnings be turned off? The default is FALSE.

K

(in weeks) How many weeks to forecast ahead. The default is K = 0, no forecasting ahead.

trajectories

Returns the posterior predictive trajectories estimated from the inner 'INLA' model. The default is FALSE.

zero_inflated

Experimental! In non-structured models, fit a model that deals with zero-inflated data. The default is FALSE. If the age_col is not missing this flag is ignored.

timeREmodel

Latent model for time random effects. The default is a second-order random walk model, "rw2".

INLAoutput

return the INLA output. Default is FALSE.

INLAoutputOnly

return only the INLA output. Default is FALSE.

WAIC

return the WAIC. The default is FALSE.

DIC

return the DIC. The default is FALSE.

...

list parameters to other functions

Valor

A list. Element 'total' is a data.frame with the nowcasting estimate: posterior 'Median', 95% credible interval ('LI', 'LS') and 50% credible interval ('LIb', 'LSb') for each onset week. If 'data.by.week' = TRUE, element 'data' holds the delay-triangle data used to fit the model. If 'age_col' is given, element 'age' holds the estimate by age class. If 'trajectories' = TRUE, element 'trajectories' holds the posterior predictive trajectories from 'inla'. If 'INLAoutput' = TRUE, the INLA output is returned as a list object named 'output'. If 'INLAoutputOnly' = TRUE, just the INLA output is returned in a list object named 'output'. If 'WAIC' = TRUE or 'DIC' = TRUE, then 'INLAoutput' is forced to be TRUE returning the INLA output and a list object named waic or dic are also returned.

Veja também

nowcasting_mgcv() for the same model fitted as a GAM with 'mgcv', which does not need 'INLA'.

Exemplos

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Needs the 'INLA' package, installed from https://www.r-inla.org/download-install
# Loading Belo Horizonte SARI dataset
data(sragBH)
output <- nowcasting_inla(dataset = sragBH,
                          date_onset = DT_SIN_PRI,
                          date_report = DT_DIGITA)
head(output$total)
} # }
